r1-handoff.finding: Pinned 11-path digest matches. The strict offline v1 seam, four exits, complete dispositions, repair/stop behavior, launched preservation, five typed fixed boundaries, renderer/CLI, registration, and all four original adversarial corrections (plus dangling/cycle controls) independently reproduce.

Rework touches only verifier/tests/contracts within it. No G3 lifecycle wiring, engine, tracker/network path, alias, portfolio policy, archive, or provenance change.

r4-quality.title: Quality vs inherited rules
r4-quality.imperative: Does the change meet the inherited project/section rules (the handoff's constraints)? Append a check per rule. Record pass/fail with a finding.
r4-quality.finding: Implementation remains a small pure verifier/renderer behind one strict serialized interface; state and failure modes are explicit, judgment stays agent-authored, and eight contract-specific checks were appended for individual review.

r5-reconciliation.title: Reconciliation check
r5-reconciliation.imperative: Does the change diverge from the recorded architecture in a way Commander must reconcile? Record pass/fail; flag a triage candidate if it is out of scope.

README/index, replan capability, G1 validator seam, pure-verifier constraint, launched/unlaunched boundary, and four-exit decision match Map Impact. G3 wiring stays out of scope. r6-fowler.title: Refactoring pass (Fowler code smells)
r6-fowler.imperative: Run the refactoring / code-smell pass (SKILL.md 'Refactoring pass'). Render a verdict on each Fowler baseline smell (long method, large class, duplicated code, feature envy, data clumps, primitive obsession, long parameter list, shotgun surgery, divergent change, message chains, speculative generality, comments-as-deodorant): flagged / overridden / absent. Smells are judgment calls, ALWAYS subordinate to the repo's documented standards - an override needs a logged standard + reason. Record the pass to templates/FOWLER_PASS.template.json, run scripts/verify_fowler_pass.py <record> (it refuses a skipped smell or an unlogged override), then record pass/fail with a finding. Do NOT silently skip this item.
constraints: Fowler smells are subordinate to documented repo standards; never hard violations
an override (smell not flagged because a standard wins) needs a logged reason
r6-fowler.finding: Visited all 12 Fowler smells; no flagged defect. Documented overrides cover the cohesive linear input verifier, three tiny named G1 field validators, serialized JSON primitives, and finite new-skill registration surfaces. The prior feature-envy defect is absent after assembled-graph validation. Fowler rail passed.

r4a-schema.title: Strict G1-compatible schema
r4a-schema.imperative: Verify exact input/result fields, types, enums, nullability, G1 nested shapes, discriminated replacements, unknown-field refusal, and assembled graph behavior.
r4a-schema.finding: Exact top-level objects reject missing/unknown fields and wrong types/enums; nested wave/forecast/uncertainty/parked/replacement shapes reuse the G1 verifier. Null is stop-only. Full issue rewrites validate in the assembled output graph, preserving valid contextual edges and rejecting dangling/cycles.

r4b-decisions.title: Four exits and dispositions
r4b-decisions.imperative: Verify all four exits, repair hold, stop nullability, complete unique classification-matched discrepancy dispositions, evidence-only/drop restrictions, and complete unlaunched dispositions.
r4b-decisions.finding: advance/repair/replan/stop all verify; repair holds wave and forecast exactly and only stop may use null. Discrepancy actions are classification-matched, complete and unique; evidence-only/drop cannot create issues; every unlaunched identity is dispositioned once.

r4c-identity.title: Identity preservation
r4c-identity.imperative: Verify completed/open partition, launched/open issue preservation when applicable, unlaunched uniqueness, and launched/unlaunched issue disjointness.
r4c-identity.finding: Completed and open IDs uniquely and disjointly partition the current wave; applicable results preserve every open launched issue object exactly; unlaunched identities are unique and unlaunched issue IDs are disjoint from all launched current-wave IDs.

r4d-escalation.title: Fixed-boundary escalation
r4d-escalation.imperative: Verify all five boundary-typed escalations, applicable=false, matching boundary, no escalation without fixed delta, and multi-fixed refusal under singular schema.
r4d-escalation.finding: All five fixed boundaries accept only their typed proposed values, require matching named escalation and applicable=false, and refuse escalation without a fixed delta. More than one distinct fixed surface fails fast under the singular v1 object.

r4e-offline.title: Offline CLI and wiring

r4e-offline.finding: Template CLI renders nonempty Wave review and Current planning truth. Verifier imports only local stdlib/G1 rail, exposes all four public helpers to executable tests/CLI, installs self-contained, and contains no tracker/network operation.
